name: Action Dispatcher runs an action through the Action Handler that registered its type and reports the handler's Result; a type nothing on this channel handles is refused as unknown; a handler on another channel is never reached
because: actionhandlernode.ts header: "This node IS the allow-list"; `trigger`: "Fires when a dispatcher has an action of this type to run"; `registered`: "True while this handler is in the allow-list"; actiondispatchernode.ts `actionCompleted`: "Fires once one action has finished and Result holds its answer"; `idle`: "Fires when the queue has drained after doing at least one thing"; `refused` / `refusalReason`: "unknown"; `actionId`: "taken from the message when it carried one". RECORDED (row C15, in the trace — outcomes are not claimable): the Dispatch of PONG at frame 3 reports `done`, where `failure`'s sentence says it "Fires when a Dispatch admitted nothing at all, because every action in it was refused" — `dispatch()` counts an action admitted once it is QUEUED (action-dispatcher.ts :453-501) and the refusal happens in the same call's pump (:573-578)

name: Waiting For goes blank once the wait for a handler expires and the action is refused
because: actiondispatchernode.ts `waitingFor`: "Action type holding the head of the queue because its handler has not registered yet; blank when nothing is waiting" — the claim is the sentence. RECORDED: the wire keeps the refused type — the expiry path (`park`'s wait timer → `unpark` → `refuseEntry`, action-dispatcher.ts :614-622, :894-905) flags no queue change, so `Waiting For` is never re-sent and a label wired to it reads the refused type until the next queue change
